feeds.title: TOPIK GUIDE
feeds.description: TOPIK GUIDE is the first and most comprehensive website exclusively focused on the Test of Proficiency in Korean. We have been helping Korean language learners succeed in the TOPIK test and achieve their goals since 2009.

feeds.title: SEOUL Korean
feeds.description: Seoul Korean language centre's blog about the Korean language. Many stories and information about learning Korean and Korean culture. We offer the best interactive and conversational Korean language courses in Singapore. We make customized textbooks and online programs so that students can study in the best Korean learning environment for them.

feeds.title: Korean Language Notes
feeds.description: Gerry Bevers shares things he notes while studying the Korean language through his blog and help readers gain advantages from his in-depth language learning articles.

feeds.title: Transparent » Korean
feeds.description: Learn Korean you won't find in a textbook with the Transparent Language Korean Blog. Unique posts teach practical vocab and grammar to build on the basics. Transparent develop innovative technology and methods to enable faster and more reliable language learning outcomes for anyone else intent on becoming more proficient in another language.

feeds.title: Dom & Hyo
feeds.description: This site is best for beginners who want to learn the Korean language with colorful illustrations. Dom is an ESL teacher in Korea and an active student. His wife, Hyo, is a native Korean who can double-check his work, so you know you're getting accurate graphics. We are a couple based in Incheon, South Korea and we have been doing fun infographics and comics about learning Korean for over 8 years now.

feeds.title: FluentU » Korean
feeds.description: Your ultimate guide to learning Korean through language immersion with real-world videos, movie trailers, music videos, news, and more. FluentU brings English to life with real-world videos. Learning English becomes fun and easy when you learn with movie trailers, music videos, news, and inspiring talks.

feeds.title: Talk To Me In Korean Blog
feeds.description: Covers Korean lessons, tips, materials and techniques for learning. Talk To Me In Korean helps you to learn Korean online with a systematic curriculum and with trusted textbooks!

feeds.title: Learn Korean through K-POP
feeds.description: Learn Korean through K-POP is for k-pop lovers and Korean learners all over the world eager to know more about the language and the culture. The blog helps you learn Korean through k-pop lyrics with words and grammar explanations.

feeds.title: LingQ » Learning Korean
feeds.description: The following section of LingQ is dedicated to learning the Korean language through kdramas, kpop, and kculture. LingQ is a vibrant community of passionate, enthusiastic language learners and native speaker tutors. The combination of awesome people and effective methodology make LingQ the best place to learn a language.

feeds.title: Ling Learn Languages » Korean
feeds.description: The following section of Ling Learn Languages is dedicated to learning the Korean language. The idea of creating a fun and effective language learning app as Ling started naturally from our own needs. In 2017, Simon and Kanyarat created the Ling app for learning Thai with fun, bite-sized games. By now, Ling covers more than 60 languages such as Thai, Serbian, Tagalog.

feeds.title: LearnKorean24 Blog
feeds.description: LearnKorean24 is a website dedicated to providing FREE Korean lessons to Korean language learners everywhere. We created this website to share our passion for the Korean language and Korean culture and to enable learners everywhere to study Korean online at their own pace.

feeds.title: A-pop-of-korean
feeds.description: Run by a self-taught Korean speaker who shares what she knows about the language, through lessons, vocabulary lists, K-pop Breakdowns, Instagram posts, and makes studying fun and accessible!

feeds.title: Retro Learns Korean
feeds.description: Blog posts about Korean and general language learning methods, motivation, and theory. Anki decks, Hanja, reading, listening, and subtitles for Korean learners. Learning Korean since September 2018. Focused on Reading and Input for now.

feeds.title: Fluent Tongues
feeds.description: Struggling to learn Korean? Master the basics of Korean from scratch with our Korean lessons. Each lesson comes with Easy and Colorful Grammar Explanations, Real-Life Situations Dialogues. Handy infographics Cheatsheet & Quizzes, and Printable Flashcards.

feeds.title: 90 Day Korean Blog
feeds.description: We're a mixed group of native Koreans and foreigners who live in Korea. We work together to give you all of the info you need about the Korean language and culture. The 90 Day Korean team creates lots of new content around the Korean language and culture regularly. We support our readers with free Korean language and culture content on our blog.

feeds.title: Hangukdrama and Korean
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Shanna, a Singaporean in her early thirties. This is a space where I share my love for the languages I know (and learn), as well as tips, methods, resources for self-studying languages.

feeds.title: Korean Language Guide
feeds.description: MKR is a place for some of the nuggets I am encountering on my journey to learning the Korean language. It began as a scrapbook for my Korean studies, which began in 2012 when I moved to Suwon, South Korea. Since then the blog has taken on a life of its own and is as much a personal journal as a learning resource.

feeds.title: Sherry Osborne
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Sherry and I've been learning Korean since June 2021. Welcome to my blog. My whole purpose for reviving my blog (it has gone through several different transitions) is to share my Korean language learning journey with you. And because I don't believe that you can learn a language without learning about the culture that goes with it, I will share that with you as well.

feeds.title: Shining Korean
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Archana. I'm a Korean-English translator, writer, and general appreciator of language and words. I'm fascinated by the space between Korean and English, and how translation can fill that space, birthing something new and breathing. I like nerding out about Korean poetry and literature, Korean internet slang, as well as Korean linguistics and language acquisition.
